reason: I do the billing myself every month, so I already know which clients get extra time for free, and mostly that's on purpose because it keeps them with us. I'm not paying £99 a month for someone to tell me what I chose to do, and I don't have a spare week to chase exports and contracts for a free audit either.
objection: I'd be sending my whole client list, tickets and contracts to a one-man outfit I've never heard of, and at the end I'd get told to send uplift emails to clients I've kept for years by not nickel-and-diming them.
would_change_my_mind: Another MSP owner I know telling me it found unbilled licences, not just goodwill time, and that it plugs straight into my PSA without me doing the exports.
